dependencies.purpose: Core reference, planning, document preparation, checklist and personal Russia-life workflows
dependencies.offlineBehavior: Core reference/planning content remains usable from local/cached assets where available

dependencies.purpose: Device/access coordination and remote administration metadata only
dependencies.dataBoundary: device/control metadata only; no passport/visa document payload or private notes
dependencies.offlineBehavior: Standalone/local-first mode remains usable where configured
dependencies.exitPath: disable or replace control-plane adapter without transferring RU_LIFE domain ownership

dependencies.purpose: Optional hosted runtime, remote device/session ledger and app-owned published state
dependencies.dataBoundary: RU_LIFE application state only; no automatic copy of user-controlled private documents
dependencies.offlineBehavior: Local/reference workflows continue; hosted/session-only features may be unavailable
dependencies.exitPath: D1/SQL and portable domain export with provider-replaceable runtime adapter

dependencies.purpose: Optional user-initiated document backup, portable export storage and cross-device transfer
dependencies.dataBoundary: explicitly selected files/exports only; sensitive identity documents should be encrypted before remote storage when consequence warrants it
dependencies.offlineBehavior: Local files/state remain usable; sync/backup pauses
dependencies.exitPath: ordinary files/JSON/ZIP can move to local storage, USB or another provider

dependencies.dataBoundary: no raw passport, visa, invitation, migration-card, address-registration, bank, insurance or credential data by default
least-privilege sanitized metadata only; not authentication/session/document authority

dependencies.purpose: Explanation, translation, planning and document-preparation assistance
dependencies.dataBoundary: only user-selected context; no automatic sensitive-document upload
dependencies.offlineBehavior: Core stored references/checklists/documents remain usable without AI
dependencies.exitPath: non-AI workflow or another optional provider

migrationBlockers: Prove a useful standalone/local-first path when hosted runtime or control plane is unavailable.
Define portable export/import for personal planning/checklist state that is not device/session authority.
Before enabling Drive sync for sensitive identity documents, define encryption, consent, deletion and restore behavior.
Keep legal/immigration guidance provenance-aware and advisory; AI output must not become canonical legal truth.
